narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Five, five, seven, seven, seven make five factors, so it is thirty five to the power five.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Thirty five to the power five would need five thirty fives multiplied together.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Different bases stay apart, and each one gets its own exponent.
